title: QuarterMaster faction.toml (schema 1)
description: A faction mod: an army that takes over the Allied or German side. Guide: the modding wiki, Part 3: https://gamiseus.github.io/wiki/faction-mods/

units.description: Art per unit. Allied side: base, sarge, para, french. Axis side: base, officer, volks.

spawn_swap.description: vanilla_tag = weapon_tag. Hands out the second weapon wherever the game hands out the first. Advanced: the tag really changes.

pools.description: Edit the random weapon pools the game draws loot and reinforcement guns from.

classes.description: The 12 class slots. Allied side only.

names.description: Allied side: soldier, french and vehicle names. Axis side: the soldier names name the German commander.

folder.description: Replaces lines in the side's main voice folder (sounds/vo/allied or sounds/vo/axis).

dirs.description: Other vanilla voice folders of the side: vanilla folder name = mod folder (e.g. frenchies = "voices_fr").

fill_missing.description: Reuse the faction's own lines when it has fewer files than vanilla.

map.description: faction file name = vanilla file name, without numbers or extension (hurt = "alliedHurt").

text.description: Game strings to replace, by name (see includes/localisation.lua).

sprites.description: Any other game image to replace while the faction is active: global name = image file, or a table with the file, the size it is shown at and where it sits.

oneOf.description: The image file (or none, to size the game's own image), one of size, scale and like, and where it sits (offset, rotate, flip). Needs "faction_sprite_sizes" in qm_features.

scale.description: A fraction of the file's own pixel size.

like.description: Another image global: shown at the size that one is shown at.

offset.description: [x, y] game pixels to move the image, right and down, inside the place the game draws it.

rotate.description: Degrees to turn the image about its middle, clockwise.

flip.description: Mirror the image about its middle: x left-right, y up-down, xy both.

draw_size.description: [width, height] game pixels to draw the picture at inside its place, while the game's code still sees the original's size.

sounds.description: Any other game sound to replace while the faction is active: global name = sound file.

explosions.description: Explosions on the game's own, with numbers changed. An [[ordnance]] entry names one by its id.

ordnance.description: The faction's ordnance: grenades, rifle grenades, mortars, artillery, air strikes and supply drops, with their own explosions, on a class skill or in place of the game's own.

skills.description: Class skills changed, replaced with another, moved to another level, removed or added.

ranks.description: The rank names shown on the faction's soldiers. Needs "ranks" in qm_features.

soldier.description: Ranks 0 to 3 (the game's Private, Private First Class, Corporal, Sergeant).

officer.description: An officer's ranks 0 to 3 (the game's Second Lieutenant, First Lieutenant, Captain, Major).

recruit.description: A soldier with no rank yet (the game's Recruit). The first soldier rank unless set.

cadet.description: An officer with no rank yet (the game's Cadet). The first officer rank unless set.

sarge.description: The Sarge's title: his name, and the word in the game's lines and texts about him. The Allies' only.

path.description: Path relative to the mod folder. No drive letters, no leading slash.

slot.description: 1 to 3: one of the class's own skills; 4 and up: new skills above them.

name.description: Its mouse-over text, before the description.

description.description: Its mouse-over text, after the name.

cooldown.description: Seconds before it is ready again.

unlock.description: The skill level it comes with (its slot, or 3 for a new skill, unless set).

game.description: A game skill: 2 (the class's own skill 2) or "light:3" (any class's).

ordnance.description: An [[ordnance]] id of this faction, thrown, fired or called in.

remove.description: The class has no skill in this slot.

name_format.description: initial: "A. Ivanov" (vanilla style). full: "Pyotr Ivanov" (needs first names).

frames.description: Per-frame image files, used instead of the folder's file for that frame.

copy_from.description: Another unit whose faction frames fill this unit's gaps.

reskin.description: Change this vanilla weapon in place.

tag.description: A new weapon's tag. Must not be a vanilla tag.

based_on.description: New weapons: copy this weapon's stats first.

name.description: Used as the squad UI text when there is no description.

sound.description: A game sound by name (springfieldSound), a file, or a name prefix: weapons/mosin loads mosin1.wav, mosin2.wav, ...

mag_sprite.description: The magazine dropped on reload: one of the game's magazines (genericMag, ppshMag, ...), an image file, or a name from [sprites].

pools.description: Random weapon pools this new weapon joins.

bonus.description: Replaces the vanilla bonus for this class when present.

max_health.description: Added (also heals by the same amount).

name.description: Shown instead of the tag in the vehicle tooltip.

parts.description: Other sprites, by the part of the game name after the tag: SecondTurret = ... on the halfTrack replaces halfTrackSecondTurret.

call_signs.description: Call signs this vehicle gets when it spawns (Allied vehicles).

explosion_preset.description: One of the game's explosions, by name or by the game's tag.

based_on.description: The explosion whose numbers it starts from (frag when left out).

kind.description: thrown: a hand grenade, as the frag (the default); rifle: fired from a rifle that takes rifle grenades, as the game's rifle grenade; mortar: a soldier's mortar rounds; artillery: a barrage called on a spot; airstrike: a plane's bombs or strafing on a spot; drop: a supply crate by parachute.

name.description: Shown on a fourth skill's button.

description.description: Shown on a fourth skill's button, after the name.

sprite.description: The image it flies as. Required for a thrown or rifle grenade; a mortar round or a shell shows only its blast.

shots.description: A mortar's rounds each time (6), a barrage's shells (5), an air strike's hits (1) or the items in a drop's crate (3).

plane.description: An air strike or a drop: the plane that flies over (the game's unless set).

contents.description: A drop: the game's loot names its crate holds, such as loot_medPack or loot_ration (the game's own mix unless set).

spread.description: How far each round or shell lands from the last (150 for a mortar, 250 for artillery).

explosion.description: An explosion of this faction by id, or one of the game's (frag when left out; rifle_grenade for a rifle grenade).

range.description: The farthest a soldier throws or fires it (1000, as the game's).

cooldown.description: Seconds before the class skill is ready again (120; 180 for a rifle grenade).

tension.description: The battle's tension after the blast (40; a rifle grenade leaves it unless set).

skill.description: The class skill that throws it instead of what it did.

slot.description: 1 to 3: one of the class's own skills; 4 and up: new skills above them.

unlock.description: The skill level it comes with (its slot, or 3 for a new skill, unless set).

icon.description: The skill's icon (a game skill's own, or the sprite for a new one, unless set).

spin.description: A thrown grenade: how fast it turns in the air (the frag's is 0.1 to 1 at random). 0 flies pointing the way it was thrown.

impact.description: A thrown grenade: it goes off where it lands, as an impact fuse, instead of bouncing.

replaces_frag.description: Soldiers of this faction's side throw it wherever they would throw a frag.

replaces_rifle_grenade.description: A rifle grenade: soldiers of this faction's side fire it wherever they would fire the game's.

replaces_mortar.description: A mortar: the faction's mortar men fire it (on the Allied side, the rifle class's third skill too).

replaces_artillery.description: Artillery: the faction's side's barrages land with its explosion.

replaces_bombing.description: An air strike: the faction's side's bombing runs drop its explosion.

replaces_strafing.description: An air strike: every hit of the faction's side's strafing runs is its explosion.

replaces_drop.description: A drop: the Allies' supply crates hold its contents.
